subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence sprint — timebox to meet Nimbus procurement window
messages:
From: Sara Norman <sara.norman@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Cho <alex.cho@nimbus-analytics.com>, procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence needed to hit Jan 20 PO date

Jonas — thanks for the demo last week. Procurement needs the SOC 2 Type II report and supporting evidence to route the PO internally; their deadline for a signed PO is Jan 20 EOB PT.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: 1) the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted okay), 2) a short bridge letter if the latest report coverage ends before Jan 1, 2027, and 3) an evidence index (control owners + artifacts) so their audit team can triage?

We understand some items may need a short turnaround — is a 48–72 hour evidence package feasible? If not, what conditional acceptance language would you recommend so we can keep the deal moving?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Norman
Senior Procurement Manager, Nimbus Analytics
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sara Norman <sara.norman@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence needed to hit Jan 20 PO date

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We're aligned to prioritize this. Quick update: I’ve looped in Security (Irene) and Sales Ops (Vivek) to coordinate.

High level plan I propose:
- Security to confirm what we can ship in 48 hours (redacted report, bridge letter draft, evidence index).
- If full evidence cannot be delivered, offer a conditional acceptance clause and a 30-day remediation commitment from Redwood with weekly checkpoints.
- HubSpot deal NBX-2027-0412: if procurement signs a conditional PO, we’ll set a delivery SLA and restrict scope to production data only.

Irene/Vivek — can you confirm feasibility? We need firm answers within 3 hours to set expectations with Nimbus.

Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence needed to hit Jan 20 PO date

Jonas — short answer: yes, with caveats.

What we can commit to within 48 hours:
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering controls through 2026-06-30.
- Draft bridge letter that confirms our control environment is substantially unchanged and states the audit window coverage and any known changes; this will be a short-form bridge (1–2 pages).
- Evidence index (spreadsheet) listing artifact names, owners, and where to request the artifact for review (not the full artifacts).

What will NOT be possible in 48 hours:
- Full artifact package or copies of encrypted logs — those require formal evidence requests and access reviews (3–7 business days).

Ask: Sales to approve a one-time exception for a condensed evidence sprint and sign-off that the customer will accept the bridge letter + redacted report for procurement to proceed. Vivek, please confirm we can offer conditional acceptance language and whether any legal/revenue approval is needed.

I will draft the bridge letter and evidence index by EOD today and attach the redacted report.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence needed to hit Jan 20 PO date

Thanks team — I'm supportive of the timeboxed approach. A few operational notes:
- We should not commit to a full artifact delivery in writing; conditional acceptance + bridge letter is acceptable procurement-side language.
- Approve a one-off sprint for evidence index creation; charge approved from account acceleration budget if needed. Marissa, please confirm budget OK.
- If Nimbus insists on additional live evidence, we'll offer an accelerated review slot (paid professional services) but not part of the standard subscription.

Jonas — give Nimbus the following conditional language for procurement: "Redwood will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter confirming that, to the best of Redwood's knowledge, there have been no material changes to our control environment since the last report. Full artifact access may be provided under a formal evidence request with mutually agreed timelines."

If the customer agrees, move forward and loop Legal only if DocuSign language needs modification.

— Vivek
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sara Norman <sara.norman@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 12:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence needed to hit Jan 20 PO date

Sara — quick follow-up with a concrete offer to meet your Jan 20 procurement window:

1) We will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a 1–2 page bridge letter by end of day Jan 12. Attached will be an evidence index that lists artifact names, owners, and retrieval paths. (Attached: SOC2_TypeII_latest_summary.pdf, bridge_letter_draft_v1.pdf, evidence_index_inventory.xlsx)
2) If Nimbus needs full artifacts for legal review, we can initiate a formal evidence request; expected turnaround is 3–7 business days.
3) Conditional procurement language: "Redwood will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter confirming there are no known material control changes since the last report; full artifact access will be provisioned under a formal evidence request subject to mutually agreed timelines."

If Nimbus agrees to proceed on that basis, we'll mark NBX-2027-0412 as 'PO pending — conditional acceptance' in HubSpot and route paperwork.

Please reply with acceptance or any edits to the conditional language.

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Sara Norman <sara.norman@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Cho <alex.cho@nimbus-analytics.com>, procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence needed to hit Jan 20 PO date

Jonas — appreciate the quick coordination and the attachments. Nimbus accepts the conditional procurement language as written. We will proceed to issue a conditional PO by Jan 18, and we expect the redacted report + bridge letter to be delivered by Jan 12 as committed.

Next steps for Redwood: please send the redacted report and bridge letter to procurement and copy legal procurement at procurement@nimbus-analytics.com. Also include the evidence index so our internal security team can triage which artifacts they need for follow-up.

Sara
